versions.changelog:
- Branding updated: "Official" designation removed; now described as "WayinVideo AI video editing and analysis suite."
- Documentation streamlined in the description for broader clarity and conciseness.
- No code or functional changes in this release.
- All core usage instructions and features remain unchanged.

Version 1.0.1

- Documentation and guidance improved in SKILL.md without any code or file changes.
- No functional changes; usage, commands, and capabilities remain the same.
- No update action required for existing users.

WayinVideo 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches the official WayinVideo AI suite for advanced video editing and analysis, supporting highlight extraction, natural language video search, content summarization, and transcription.
- Supports both online URLs (YouTube, TikTok, etc.) and local file workflows with flexible export options such as aspect ratio, captioning, and AI reframing.
- Includes a persistent configuration system for saving user preferences and enabling seamless automation.
- Provides CLI tools optimized for agents, background polling, and subagent workflows for efficient large-scale video tasks.
- Detailed usage scenarios and documentation references for task selection, result reporting, and advanced user-customization included.
